entity_raw.definition_raw: Blood SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): WarAssociated Deities: Achaekek, Ajids, Akuma, Chaugnar Faugn, Chugarra, Deskari, Eiseth, Flauros, Fumeiyoshi, General Susumu, Gorum, Hadregash, Izyagna, Kitumu, Nergal, Nulgreth, Ovonovo, Rovagug, Sekhmet, Shiggarreb, Sobek, Szuriel, Tamede, Thremyr, Urazra, Urgathoa, Xiquiripat, Zura, Zursvaater, ZyphusReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the weapon master power of the War domain. Wounding Blade (Su): At 8th level, you can give a weapon that you touch the wounding special weapon quality for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.Replacement Domain Spells: 3rd—vampiric touch, 5th—wall of thorns, 7th—inflict serious wounds (mass).
